blockersClosed.title: Verification-laundering receipt classifier
blockersClosed.problem: Accreted over the review: (1) matching a test/spec filename ANYWHERE minted kind:test succeeded for `cat paginate.test.js`; (2) runner/lint/build MENTIONS (`echo npm test`) minted receipts; (3) status-masking shapes (`|| true`, `| tee`, `; echo`, quoted separators, top-level background `&`) could launder a masked/backgrounded run as succeeded; (4) the runtime branch only confirmed a test filename appeared AFTER a runtime head, not that the runtime EXECUTED it — so eval/print/check/compile/format/build modes (`node -e`, `node --check`, `node -p`, `python -c`, `python -m py_compile`, `ruby -c`, `deno fmt`, `bun build`) all laundered, and backtick/heredoc content was misread as execution; (5) an executable head could still be an info/dry-run mode (`--help`/`--version`/`--collect-only`/`--print-config`/`--show-config`/`--dry-run`/`make -n`); (6) `\b`/prefix matching let look-alike binaries (`node-wrapper`, `vitest-report`, `jest-helper`) launder; (7) attached/equal option forms (`node -e"…"`, `--eval=…`, `-p"…"`, `python -c"…"`, `-mpy_compile`) hid the flag from an exact-token check, and collect/list/no-run aliases (`cargo test --no-run`, `vitest list`, `jest --listTests`, `pytest --co`, `make --just-print`) still minted receipts; (8) top-level shell comments were not recognized, so `echo safe # ; npm test` / `true # && node paginate.test.js` split at the commented-out separator and the runner leaked into a phantom segment; (9) a verification reached via a conditional guard could be SKIPPED yet still minted a receipt — `false && node paginate.test.js` emitted test:failed and `true || node paginate.test.js` emitted test:unknown though the test never ran; (10) the info/dry-run handling was a growing cross-tool DENYLIST (accept unless a listed non-run flag is present), so undocumented no-verification modes kept slipping through — `go test -list .` (test:succeeded), `make -q`/`--question`/`-t` (build:succeeded), `tsc --init`/`--listFilesOnly` (build:succeeded), `eslint --env-info` (lint:succeeded), `pytest --fixtures`/`--markers` (test:succeeded), and `npm run test --if-present` (test:succeeded when no test script exists). A denylist always lags by one probe; successful process exit alone is not evidence the claimed verification ran.
blockersClosed.fix: Rewrote the classifier around a quote/escape-aware WORD TOKENIZER per shell segment. For each executed segment: resolve the EXACT executable basename (strip leading NAME=value env assignments and wrappers sudo/time/env/…; unwrap npx / pnpm dlx / yarn dlx), NEVER a `\b`/substring match. Normalize option names so attached/equal value forms cannot hide a flag (`--eval=x`->`--eval`, `-e"x"`->`-e`, `-mpytest`->`-m`). Recognize the execution FORM and identify the ACTUAL script target rather than regex-scanning later args: reject node eval/print/check (`-e/--eval/-p/--print/--check/-c`), python inline `-c` and `-m py_compile`, ruby `-c/-e`, `deno fmt/lint`, `bun build`; require a *.test.*/*.spec.* positional for a bare-runtime test; keep explicit runner modes (`python -m pytest/unittest`, `deno test`, `bun test`). NO-VERIFICATION HANDLING IS NOW PER-TOOL POSITIVE VALIDATION, NOT A GROWING DENYLIST (Codex 1d107bb9, PM fa822906): a succeeded receipt must mean the claimed verification RAN, not merely that a capable binary exited zero. A shared help/version floor (`--help`/`-h`/`-?`/`--version`/`-V`) rejects every recognized CLI; beyond that each tool matches its OWN documented non-run modes — pytest `--collect-only`/`--co`/`--fixtures`/`--markers`/`--setup-plan`/…, jest `--listTests`/`--showConfig`/`--init`/`--clearCache`, eslint `--env-info`/`--print-config`/`--inspect-config`/`--init`, tsc `--init`/`--showConfig`/`--listFilesOnly`, make no-recipe modes `-q`/`--question`/`-t`/`--touch`/`-n`/`--just-print`/`--dry-run`/`--recon`, `go test -list` (single-dash long flag, attached `-list=` normalized), `cargo test --no-run`, and package-manager `--if-present` (exits zero when the script is absent). Any invocation not matching a positive verification form mints nothing. Emit NO receipt when the command contains command substitution (backtick or `$(`) or a heredoc — data is not execution. Strip shell comments FIRST (quote-aware: an unquoted `#` at a word start runs to end-of-line) so a commented-out separator/runner cannot leak into a phantom segment. STATUS + CONDITIONAL GUARDS: the classifier now takes the observed AGGREGATE exit status and returns the honest per-run status or null. A run in the final foreground UNCONDITIONAL position (start, `;`, `|`) owns the aggregate (succeeded/failed/unknown). A run reached via a conditional mints a receipt only when the aggregate PROVES the branch executed: `pred && run` -> only a succeeded aggregate (proves the whole chain ran+passed); `pred || run` -> only a failed aggregate (proves pred failed so run executed+failed). Any other case -> no receipt (never test:failed/test:unknown for a possibly-skipped run). `unknown` is reserved for a run that DEFINITELY executed but is masked by a later/piped segment or backgrounded with `&`; it never means 'may have been skipped'. Redirections `2>&1`/`&>out`/`>&2` stay foreground.

Plus: non-run runtime modes (node -e/-p/--check, python -c/-m py_compile, ruby -c, deno fmt, bun build) mint nothing; command-substitution/heredoc mint nothing; help/version/config modes across all kinds mint nothing; exact-basename negatives (node-wrapper/vitest-report/jest-helper/eslint-report/webpack-info/tsc-wrapper/pytest-cache) with a via-PATH positive (/usr/local/bin/vitest run); attached/equal + collect/list/no-run negatives (node -e"…", --eval=…, -p"…", python -c"…", -mpy_compile, cargo test --no-run, vitest list, jest --listTests, pytest --co, make --just-print) with a positive attached -mpytest; shell-comment negatives (echo safe # ; npm test, echo safe # | vitest, true # && node paginate.test.js, ...) with a quoted-# positive (echo "a # b" && node paginate.test.js still runs); conditional-guard negatives (false && node paginate.test.js -> nothing not test:failed; true || node paginate.test.js -> nothing not test:unknown) with proven-executed positives (test -f package.json && npm test -> succeeded; test -f missing.txt || node paginate.test.js -> failed); earlier negatives retained (read/copy/delete of test files; runner/lint/build mentions; quoted separators; masking pipelines->unknown; background->unknown); redirection positives stay authoritative; positives preserved (node paginate.test.js, npm/npx/pnpm/yarn/bun test, pytest, python -m pytest, go/cargo test, eslint, ruff check, tsc, make).

blockersClosed.title: Hashless SessionEnd inheriting a stale Stop hash (partial-session capture)
blockersClosed.problem: A hashless SessionEnd on the same transcript could inherit the prior Stop hash, and capture could return the earlier completed turn as a verified ended session before a genuinely later turn appended.
blockersClosed.fix: TRUST BOUNDARY IS PROVENANCE, NOT TIMING. (1) At the hook: a `session_end` capture is only ever produced when SessionEnd carries its OWN authoritative last_assistant_message hash (durable same-event identity). A hashless terminal event NEVER fabricates a session_end with a borrowed hash; it preserves the prior authoritative Stop pointer EXACTLY (captureEvent:"stop", same hash) — an explicitly-labeled last-completed-turn capture, not a verified ended session. (2) At capture: readStableTranscript returns a transcript ONLY when its final assistant message hashes to the recorded pointer hash. Once a later turn is on disk, the final message IS that later turn, whose hash can never equal the recorded one, so capture fails closed no matter how long the transcript then settles. The confirmation window is demoted to defense-in-depth latency shaping, explicitly NOT the trust boundary.
blockersClosed.regressions: tools/session/__tests__/capture.test.mjs — (a) Codex's exact timing: capture starts, turn 2 appends at 450ms, capture fails closed; (b) provenance-not-timing: turn 2 appends at 60ms and FULLY SETTLES for the rest of a 1000ms timeout (a quiet window of any finite length is satisfied) — capture STILL fails closed on the hash mismatch, proving timing alone cannot pass. tools/session/__tests__/hook.test.mjs — hashless SessionEnd preserves captureEvent:"stop"+hash (no fabricated session_end); a genuinely later Stop(turn2) overwrites with its own authoritative hash; a different transcript never inherits a stale hash.

The rendered explanation is unchanged, so the >=90% context-blind gate is preserved without re-scoring.

The classifier is conservative by design: false negatives are preferred to fabricated verification. A test run via an unconventional filename, a fully quoted compound form, a backgrounded run, or a status-masked pipeline yields no succeeded receipt (unknown or none) rather than a laundered success.

The hashless-SessionEnd guarantee is provenance-based, not timing-based: capture fails closed on a hash mismatch regardless of when a later turn appends. The confirmation window is defense-in-depth latency shaping only.
